entities.name: Erg Desert
entities.description: A hostile desert covering western Almaaz in the Terisian Isles on Dominaria.

entities.name: Almaaz
entities.description: Island in the Terisian Isles where the Erg Desert lies.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane where the Terisian Isles lie.

entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event after which the Sea of Almaaz formed and the Erg Desert spread.

entities.name: Wyrvil
entities.description: Fractious orc kingdom occupying the western half of the erg.

entities.name: Sumifa
entities.description: City sheltering in a river valley near the coast.

entities.name: Fallajia
entities.description: Land east of the erg with a gentler climate; its Fallaji ride kavu into the desert.

entities.name: Neffia
entities.description: Cave system with a life-saving oasis that sheltered the Neffian people.

entities.name: Borderlands
entities.description: Land on a smaller island southwest across a Lat-Nam Strait.

events.summary: After the Flooding of Terisiare and the creation of the Sea of Almaaz, the Erg Desert comes to cover western Almaaz.
events.quote: the Erg Desert came to cover almost the entire western half of the island of Almaaz

relations.quote: The Erg Desert covers western Almaaz

relations.note: orc kingdom occupying its western half
relations.quote: The fractious orc kingdom of Wyrvil occupies the western half of the erg
